John,

I know you're waiting on word that 8D is ready, and I wanted to give you the straight story rather than just pass along the "cleared" note from back in May. I'd rather flag them now than have them bounce back on us after we call it done.

Where it stands:

Done and verified
- In-house repairs: drywall patches, kitchen faucet replacement, and the bedroom/living-room paint touch-ups.
- Carpet: cleaned and seam fix completed by Victor Rios.
- Deep clean: completed by Isela.
- Refrigerator swap: completed 6/25.

Still open (needs to close before we call 8D ready)
1. Kitchen garbage disposal jam (OPS-227). This came off my 6/22 Las Palmas ticket run. The other two stops that morning (12B closet hardware, 3A sink drip) got closed out, but the 8D disposal was left sitting in "In Review" and never actually verified. I've moved it back to In Progress. It needs a reset/clear and a run-test, then it can close. Worth re-checking anyway since the fridge swap happened in that same kitchen on 6/25.
2. Bedroom outlet cover plate. This was the second punch-list item from Jaime's 5/26 QC walk — the missing cover plate on the east-wall outlet by the primary bedroom closet, which is a safety/code item. It got reported as "taken care of" on 5/27, but that note mentioned the baseboard and touch-up paint, not the outlet cover, and the photo confirmation QC asked for never got posted. So I can't confirm it's actually installed. I opened OPS-1000 to physically verify it and install a cover plate if it's missing.

Non-blocking follow-up
- HVAC coil cleaning should be added to the next preventive-maintenance cycle. The final walk noted it's out of scope for this turn, so it doesn't hold up leasing — just shouldn't get lost.

What it'll take to finish
Both open items are quick — a disposal reset/run-test and a five-minute cover-plate check/install. I'll handle both on my next Las Palmas run and post photo confirmation in #make-ready. Once those are verified, 8D is genuinely rent-ready and I'll confirm it with you. I've also corrected the make-ready records so they show In Progress instead of the stale "Ready" entry, and there's a lease signing pending on this unit, so I'd hold off locking a move-in date until I confirm both are done.

I'll follow up the moment they're closed.

Thanks,
James
